y-m-09-04.title: Qiyaasidda culeyska hal tufaax iyadoo la isticmaalayo miisaan isu dheellitiran
y-m-09-04.topic: Culeyska (g) iyo helidda xad iyadoo la barbardhigayo miisaan isu dheellitiran
y-m-09-04.goal: Xitaa haddii aadan ogaan karin qiimaha sax ah, sheeg xad culeyska ah natiijooyinka isbarbardhigga, ku dhimi xadka indho-indheyn cusub, oo ka fikir xadka ah in qalabka aad hadda haysato uu sii dhimi karo iyo in kale.
y-m-09-04.material:
Waxaad tufaax ku dhigtay hal saxan oo miisaan isu dheellitiran ah, miisaannadana saxanka kale si aad u barbardhigto. Dhinaca ka culus wuu hoos dhacaa, haddii miisaannadu isle'eg yihiinna, waa siman yahay. Waxaa jira dhowr miisaan oo 50 g, 100 g, 200 g, iyo 500 g mid walba ah. Dheh waxaa jira dhowr tufaax oo si sax ah isu culeys ah, culeyska 1 tufaaxna waa tiro dabiici ah oo g ah.
Indho-indheyn 1: 1 tufaax vs. laba miisaan oo 200 g ah → dhinaca tufaaxa ayaa hoos dhacay.
Indho-indheyn 2: 1 tufaax vs. hal miisaan oo 500 g ah → dhinaca miisaanka ayaa hoos dhacay.
